title: Any feedback, recommendation or constructive criticism?
author: Upbeat_Ad_6119
selftext:
Hello everyone! 

I made this game for Epic AI MegaJam 2026, and I got several positive feedback, but they was just one-liners, and It would be nice to get more deep feedback, recommendations what could be done better. I see a lot of things that should be improved, and I already have plan, but its really important for me to see some other perspectives, I would really appreciate your time and effort.

Small description how ai was used:  
1. Characters sprites/animations was done by fal.ai (I have intentionally kept that small amount of frames for animations, and overall it looks a bit slop but it kinda fits in game art style in my opinion)  
2. Sounds was fully done with claude and I fill that I don't like some detail about how it sounds, but I'm not sure what exactly. Maybe background noise should be tweaked a bit.  
3. All other visual details (beside characters), was done entirely with code (Claude), procedural textures/sprites, a lot of shaders for fire distortion and visual artifacts for example.

comments.author: Stefan474
comments.body:
my main feedback is that you do not show a lot. just the main concept. show a few interesting ways to use the cut. 

also one liners in the middle of the screen are very obviously claudisms and also seem unneeded so I'd either remove them or keep them for important info.

cool concept tho

replies.author: Upbeat_Ad_6119
replies.body: Totally agreed with the one liners in the middle, I have even removed intentionally some of them (video is a bit earlier version of game), but some of them are still here. Texts are thing that I'm struggle the most, it needs a lot of time and manual work to properly write and place everything, I did not had much time to audit each claude written text by hands, I mostly focused on puzzle related hint texts to make it playable and understandable. All texts definitely should be reworked manually

replies.author: Stefan474
replies.body: I'd go a step further and say to cut the popup text completely. It doesn't feel like it adds to the 'vision' of the game nor improve the UX.

comments.author: blastronomical
comments.body: Looks like you've actually got an art style and a unique game mechanic or two, which puts you light years beyond 99.9% of the AI "game demos" I've seen over the last few months. Keep it up!

replies.author: Upbeat_Ad_6119
replies.body: Ow, thanks! I have much more ideas regarding the mechanics and level design. I would keep doing it

comments.author: Kitchen-Beautiful545
comments.body:
In the browser build’s first scene, “Dead Air,” the striped cut preview and arrows made it clear which bit of the set would disappear. After releasing the drag, the two platforms joined, but the paper label still said “drag across the gap to cut it out.” That’s the one bit of writing I’d change first. Let the label disappear with the cut, or swap it to “walk across the splice” once the seam is closed. That makes the player’s next move clear using the same paper-sign style that already works.

https://i.redd.it/pid4w32jkf2i1.jpeg

replies.author: Upbeat_Ad_6119
replies.body: I agreed that it might be confusing, but from other hand, I was imagined that texts like general hints, something similar to guiding about the controls, u know? not something dynamic that might depend on the user action. And also the reason why I put this texts on the platforms, is that i love the idea that it's part of the set and decorations, feels like "director" guiding us through level, and also i love that effect that every texts here is baked with texture and we can simply cut out even this parts of texts, it might be used in the future as puzzle mechanic, something kinda reordering words to solve something. changing all this texts on flight, would look a bit weird with concept of the game. What are u saying should be achieved with some other ways, but I'm not sure would it feel better or not.. I even thought about making some smart system to analyze players actions, and show the hints bason on how good or bad they doing, something like "show hint if i did not passed the door within 15secs", so yeah I'm still need to figure out that things related to the texts and hints
